review_scope.limitations: This is an identity, denominator, source-scope and inference review. It independently reopens the Cao primary case series only; it does not claim fresh full-primary verification of AAN, Chaves or Mehrabian passages.

findings: ManNAc remains N-acetylmannosamine in GNE myopathy, separate from aceneuramic acid and other pathway interventions.
SCARB2 treatment is miglustat; preceding imiglucerase is a distinct intervention and contributes no miglustat nonresponders.
Naltrexone is an active-care comparator, not new ruxolitinib efficacy or a newly counted candidate.
37 treated ManNAc plus 17 treated placebo equals 54; the exact endpoint-analysis N remains null.
Registry actual enrollment 54 and older planned 51 are separately stored; no pooled or inferred attrition denominator.
AAN and Neurology versions are treated as one report, and abstract-level uncertainty is preserved.
Baseline discovery/historical-topics.csv T060 already contains the exact AAN2026-006191 URL.
Baseline portfolio-register.json T060 review is repository_registry with fresh_primary_review=false, matching the new file.
All three updates have new_candidate=false. Existing candidate identifiers R9-NL-01 and R6-NL-01 are retained.

checks.domain: SCARB2 patient lineage and contrary evidence
findings: Chaves describes two siblings but adds one miglustat-treated person, patient2.
Current ledger 1 Chaves + 1 Quraishi + 2 Atasu + 1 Colucci = 5 people across 4 reports.
Round 9 was explicitly a bounded four-person retrieved set; the new file does not falsely correct a historical global census.
The Atasu pair retains its shared-family relationship and unfavorable trajectories; no response probability is estimated.
Exact Chaves allele remains null, and primary-access limits are explicitly disclosed.
checks.baseline_locator: research/rounds/round9/new-candidate-screen.md, R9-NL-01 case table and denominator paragraph

checks.domain: Naltrexone cases, cointerventions and dose inference
findings: The independent Cao primary-source recheck confirms three biopsy-proven patients and the recorded treatment sequences.
Cao case1 includes topical rescue/maintenance; case3 includes changing systemic and procedural rescue.
Case2 stopping and restarting at different historical doses is not a randomized dose comparison.
The fourth record is the separate Mehrabian case; its BAD presentation is deduplicated.
Four records are explicitly selected cases rather than the all-treated denominator, and are not pooled with ruxolitinib.
No dose escalation, dose superiority, chronic safety margin or head-to-head effect is inferred.
checks.primary_locator: Cao et al., JAMA Dermatology, Methods and Results Cases 1-3; Discussion dosing claim explicitly not adopted

findings: ManNAc source scope is an investigator abstract plus indexed registry, not a recovered full analysis dataset.
Chaves scope is abstract/indexed original passages; complete PDF and genotype audit are not claimed.
Cao original HTML scope is independently confirmed. Mehrabian remains primary abstract/indexed passages, not a newly retrieved complete PDF.
Ceccacci remains abstract-level; review metadata contributes no primary dose-response data.

checks.domain: Phenotype/function versus mechanism and causal inference
findings: ManNAc no significant benefit is not converted into zero possible effect or proven target-engagement failure.
SCARB2 daily-function gains remain uncontrolled observations; renal repair, survival benefit and death/drug causality are not inferred.
HHD author-estimated improvement is not equated with a validated trial endpoint; symptomatic control is separated from ATP2C1/SPCA1 correction.

checks.domain: No unintended current clinical or experimental actions
findings: Historical regimens are labelled as historical evidence, not prescribing advice.
HHD comparator and cointervention statements are documentary requirements for the existing future proof plan, with no present trial execution or patient treatment instruction.
Each update expressly limits current activities to public-document analysis and excludes outreach, purchases and experiments.

independently_reopened_primary_source.title: Variable Response to Naltrexone in Patients With Hailey-Hailey Disease
independently_reopened_primary_source.purpose: Resolve exact historical treatment-sequence/cointervention and dose-superiority concerns without reopening the wider search
independently_reopened_primary_source.outcome: No disagreement with reviewed case extraction or limitations

review_validity: Applies only to the six file hashes recorded above; content changes require a scoped follow-up review of the changed claims.
